# Murman Engineering India Pvt Ltd

> Navi Mumbai firm delivering near-zero, climate-resilient green buildings in Maharashtra: energy-efficient design and green certification, low-carbon materials and circularity, clean construction and compliance, and resilient delivery and quality. Work is aligned with UNEP's goal of near-zero emission and resilient buildings by 2030 and India's energy codes and net zero 2070 path. Founded 2025, building on 35 years of construction delivery by Lalit Enterprises (since 1991; 55+ buildings).

## Services (four bundles)
- Near-zero design and green certification: energy-efficient, passively cooled design to BEE's ECSBC and ENS 2024 codes; IGBC, GRIHA, LEED and EDGE certification from pre-certification to final rating; green FSI under Maharashtra's UDCPR (3 to 7% additional built-up area in Navi Mumbai, Thane, Kalyan-Dombivli, Pune and other UDCPR areas; not Greater Mumbai, which follows DCPR 2034), held to the occupancy certificate.
- Low-carbon materials and circularity: UNEP's avoid, shift, improve approach applied to the bill of quantities; PSC, GGBS and LC3 cements, AAC blocks and recycled aggregate at equal or lower cost; supplier sourcing and execution.
- Clean construction and compliance: dust and air quality management to municipal and MPCB guidelines, construction and demolition waste recovery under the 2025 rules, environmental clearance and compliance reporting with accredited partners.
- Resilient delivery and quality: flooring, tiling, stone and waterproofing by a 35-year team, stage-wise quality checks with photographic records, handover with an occupant guide to saving water and energy.
